description:
Scope: test-only follow-up for lib/zaq/engine/connector_lifecycle.ex lines 44, 78, 87, 136, 137, 165, 178, 180, 214, 217, 219; line 44 is a default-arity declaration rather than independently executable code. Exclusive test paths: test/zaq/engine/connector_lifecycle_test.exs (new isolated cases and enhanced per-process router stub), test/zaq/engine/connector_archive_persistence_test.exs (existing persisted retry/locked-boundary assertions only if necessary). Do not change production, docs, or other tests. Existing parent zaq-emb.27.26 owns the feature; this issue owns only gap tests; no dependency added without confirmation of scheduling.
Functional spec / tests before implementation: (1) archive/2 with ID/provider/kind on saved retrieval config (44) and archive(nonmap, actor, []) or archive(map, actor, nonlist) returns {:error, :invalid_request} (78); no dispatch/mutation. (2) archive saved data-source config, get new context revision, retry archived ID; assert watch_teardown already_archived/count 0, no stop callback or ingress teardown, reconciliation called, runtime sync still occurs and status already_archived (87). (3) per-test Router using Process.get(:teardown_response/:runtime_response/:router_mode) sends exact %Event to owner, returns %Event response, or a non-Event; no global state: teardown plain {:error, :provider_down} wraps once (136); unexpected :unexpected yields {:error, {:ingress_teardown_failed, {:unexpected_response, :unexpected}}} (137); both keep row live, suppress runtime and cleanup. (4) after successful archive, runtime {:ok, :stopped} yields :synced (178); runtime :unexpected yields {:pending, {:unexpected_response, :unexpected}} (180) with archived row and no second teardown on retry. (5) non-Event router return at ingress exercises 214, returns ingress_teardown_failed/channels_unavailable, remains live; router raises at ingress exercises 217, router exits at ingress exercises 219. Repeat bad-return/raise/exit on runtime after successful ingress in focused cases only if needed to prove post-commit pending classification; verify persisted archived and result runtime {:pending, :channels_unavailable}. Assert exact confidential :channels event opts/action, scoped config ID, actor, no secret in public result; use assert_received/refute_received and Repo.get! after synchronous archive, no sleeps/polling. Retain existing Zaq.DataCase async:true, per-test unique records, Process dictionary settings local to test process (router executes inline); no Mox/internal mocking, only existing injected router and watch collaborator, real ChannelConfig/Repo/transaction. Existing integration test is async:false due global Application env: do not introduce new global mutation; restore if touching. No new E2E (backend-only coverage); property assessment: strict invalid-ID and exact-scope fail-closed are broad inputs, add bounded StreamData property for malformed ID strings via context/3 (exclude valid positive integer strings), assert connector_not_found and no effects; avoid redundant Cartesian variants. Line 165 blocker: ChannelConfig.archive/1 uses Ecto.Changeset.change and Repo.update on the locked valid row, with no injected persistence seam; ordinary valid records cannot naturally yield {:error, changeset}. Do not fabricate DB constraint corruption or alter production for coverage. If a legitimate fixture/constraint is found, assert {:error, {:archive_failed, changeset}} and rollback with no runtime sync; otherwise document unreachable exception and leave line uncovered pending production-trigger evidence. Line 44 may remain uncovered because a def default head emits no independently executable branch; verify fresh line report before claiming it is a gap.
Validation when implementing (not in planning): isolated mix test test/zaq/engine/connector_lifecycle_test.exs test/zaq/engine/connector_archive_persistence_test.exs; mix q via Context Mode; after approved review fresh mix coveralls.json then mix coverup per workflow; inspect branch/line report for these lines and document unavoidable 44/165 exception; final mix precommit only at human final approval gate. Action reuse assessment: not applicable, no executable operation or Action changes; tests use existing archive/context boundaries. Documentation: no docs changes; record coverage exceptions and validation in this issue and PR. No implementation or test execution authorized by this planning task.
